- `description` (string): sav-list-item: the second line.

Slots:

- `(default)`: Title of the row.
- `prefix`: Icon or avatar at the start.
- `suffix`: Badge, button or value at the end.

Example — Card list:

```html
<sav-list appearance="card" style="max-width: 26rem; width: 100%">
  <sav-list-item description="ada@example.com" href="#list"><sav-avatar slot="prefix" size="sm" label="Ada Lovelace"></sav-avatar>Ada Lovelace</sav-list-item>
  <sav-list-item description="Last seen yesterday" href="#list"><sav-avatar slot="prefix" size="sm" label="Alan Turing" variant="primary"></sav-avatar>Alan Turing</sav-list-item>
  <sav-list-item description="3 new messages"><sav-icon slot="prefix" name="mail"></sav-icon>Inbox<sav-badge slot="suffix">3</sav-badge></sav-list-item>
</sav-list>
```

### Table — `<sav-table>`

Styles the normal table you put inside: borders, stripes and hover from the style, a scroll area on small screens, and sorting by clicking a header.

Documentation: https://www.savcomponents.com/#table

Attributes:

- `sortable` (boolean): Click a header to sort (numbers as numbers); data-no-sort on a th skips it, data-value on a td sorts by that value.
- `striped` (boolean): 
- `hover` (boolean): Highlights the row under the pointer.
- `compact` (boolean): Less padding.
- `appearance` (card · plain): Default card.
- `class="num"` (th · td): Right-aligned numbers.
- `label` (string): Name of the scroll area for screen readers when the table is wider than its frame (then the frame can be reached with Tab and scrolled with the arrows). Default: the caption, or "Table".

Events:

- `sav-sort`: After sorting. detail.column, detail.direction

Methods:

- `sort(index)`: Sorts by a column.

Example — Sortable, striped:

```html
<sav-table sortable striped hover style="width: 100%">
  <table>
    <thead><tr><th>Name</th><th>Role</th><th class="num">Tasks</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><td>Ada</td><td>Editor</td><td class="num">12</td></tr>
      <tr><td>Alan</td><td>Viewer</td><td class="num">4</td></tr>
      <tr><td>Grace</td><td>Admin</td><td class="num">27</td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
</sav-table>
```

## Media

### Carousel — `<sav-carousel · sav-slide>`

Slides that scroll sideways — only images, or image and text. Arrow buttons, dots, swipe with fingers, drag with the mouse, arrow keys (each can be turned off), more than one slide at a time, loop and an autoplay that stops on hover, on focus and with reduced motion.

Documentation: https://www.savcomponents.com/#carousel

Attributes:

- `label` (string): sav-carousel: name for screen readers.
- `per-view` (number): Slides visible at once (default 1).
- `loop` (boolean): After the last comes the first.
- `autoplay` (ms): Moves by itself (default 5000 ms); pauses on hover and focus, off with reduced motion.
- `no-arrows` (boolean): Hides the previous and next buttons (on touch screens they are hidden anyway).
- `touch-arrows` (boolean): Shows the arrows on touch screens too.
- `no-hint` (boolean): On touch screens, no “grab and move” hint the first time the carousel shows up.
- `no-dots` (boolean): Hides the dots.
- `no-swipe` (boolean): Turns off swiping with fingers and dragging with the mouse.
- `no-keyboard` (boolean): Turns off the arrow keys.
- `controls` (inside · outside): Where the arrows sit.
- `src · alt · heading · text · ratio · overlay`: sav-slide: image, its text, the text over the image.

Events:

- `sav-slide`: The visible slide changed. detail.index

Methods:

- `go(index)`: Shows a slide.

Example — Images:

```html
<sav-carousel label="Gallery" loop style="max-width: 30rem">
  <sav-slide src="docs/sample.svg" alt="Hills at sunset"></sav-slide>
  <sav-slide src="docs/media/poster.jpg" alt="Blue gradient"></sav-slide>
  <sav-slide src="docs/sample.svg" alt="Hills, again" style="filter: hue-rotate(120deg)"></sav-slide>
</sav-carousel>
```

Example — Image and text, two at a time:

```html
<sav-carousel label="Stories" per-view="2" style="width: 100%">
  <sav-slide src="docs/sample.svg" alt="" heading="Mountain cabin" text="Two hours from the nearest town."></sav-slide>
  <sav-slide src="docs/media/poster.jpg" alt="" heading="Lake house" text="Swim before breakfast."></sav-slide>
  <sav-slide src="docs/sample.svg" alt="" heading="City loft" text="Everything at walking distance." style="filter: hue-rotate(200deg)"></sav-slide>
  <sav-slide src="docs/sample.svg" alt="" heading="Seaside" text="Overlay text on the image." overlay style="filter: hue-rotate(300deg)"></sav-slide>
</sav-carousel>
```

### Video — `<sav-video>`

A video in a frame with the corners of the style, a fixed ratio and a poster with a big play button, then its own control bar: play, the progress bar and the time, mute and volume, full screen — and on request back and forward 10 seconds, speed, loop, captions and picture in picture. The bar hides while playing; keys: Space, arrows, M, F, C. When the player is small, the controls that do not fit move into a ⋯ menu; controls chooses which ones show, native-controls uses the browser’s bar.

Documentation: https://www.savcomponents.com/#video

Attributes:

- `src` (url): Or elements inside.
- `poster` (url): Image before playing.
- `ratio` (16:9 · 4:3 · 1:1 · 9:16): 
- `caption · label` (string): Line below; name of the play button.
- `controls` (list): Which controls show, separated by spaces: play skip seek time mute volume speed loop captions pip fullscreen (default: play seek time mute volume fullscreen; captions and pip also need the video to allow them). none: no controls at all, not even the big play button — only the video (with autoplay muted loop for a background video).
- `native-controls` (boolean): The browser’s own control bar instead of this one.
- `autoplay · muted · loop` (boolean): loop starts the video again at the end; the Loop button in the bar turns it on and off (and sets the attribute).
- `replay-label` (string): At the end (without loop) the last frame dims and a big Replay button shows: its text (default "Replay").
- `<track kind="captions">` (child): Captions: the CC button appears.
- `auto-text` (boolean): The play icon is black or white, whichever is readable on the play button (WCAG AA, at least 4.5:1), also with your own colours.

Events:

- `play · pause · ended`: 

Methods:

- `play() · pause()`: 
- `video`: Property: the element.

Example — Large:

```html
<sav-video src="docs/media/sample.mp4" poster="docs/media/poster.jpg" label="Gradient demo" caption="A 4-second sample made for this page: try the controls, the keys and full screen." style="max-width: 46rem"></sav-video>
```

Example — Small, square, with the browser controls:

```html
<sav-video src="docs/media/sample.mp4" poster="docs/media/poster.jpg" ratio="1:1" style="max-width: 16rem"></sav-video>
<sav-video src="docs/media/sample.mp4" poster="docs/media/poster.jpg" native-controls style="max-width: 22rem"></sav-video>
```

### Audio — `<sav-audio>`

A player in the style with the controls of the video player: play/pause, the progress bar and the time, mute and volume — and on request back and forward 10 seconds, speed and loop; title, artist and cover. Keys: Space or K play, ← → 5 seconds, ↑ ↓ volume, M mute. When the player is small, the controls that do not fit move into a ⋯ menu (and in a very small one the cover steps aside); controls chooses which ones show, native-controls uses the browser’s own player.

Documentation: https://www.savcomponents.com/#audio

Attributes:

- `src` (url): Or elements inside.
- `title · artist` (string): 
- `cover` (url): A small picture.
- `loop · autoplay · muted` (boolean): loop starts again by itself at the end (the Loop button turns it on and off); autoplay starts on its own (browsers allow sound only after the person has used the page).
- `replay-label` (string): At the end (without loop) the play button turns into Replay: its name (default "Replay").
- `controls` (list): Which controls show, separated by spaces: play skip seek time mute volume speed loop (default: play seek time mute volume). none: no controls, only title, artist and cover (it plays with autoplay or from code).
- `native-controls` (boolean): The browser’s own player instead of the library’s.
- `auto-text` (boolean): The play icon is black or white, whichever is readable on the play button (WCAG AA, at least 4.5:1), also with your own colours.

CSS parts:

- `b`: a
- `c`: o
- `p`: l
- `t`: i
- `a`: r
- `c`: o
- `m`: u
- `a`: u

Events:

- `play · pause · ended`: 

Methods:

- `play() · pause()`: 
- `audio`: Property: the element (volume, playbackRate, currentTime…).

Example — Player:

```html
<sav-audio src="docs/media/sample.wav" title="Little melody" artist="SavComponents" cover="docs/media/poster.jpg" style="max-width: 34rem"></sav-audio>
```

Example — Narrow (the ⋯ menu), chosen controls, the browser’s player:

```html
<sav-audio src="docs/media/sample.wav" title="Little melody" style="max-width: 20rem"></sav-audio>
<sav-audio src="docs/media/sample.wav" title="Only play, seek and time" controls="play seek time" style="max-width: 26rem; margin-top: 1rem"></sav-audio>
<sav-audio src="docs/media/sample.wav" native-controls style="max-width: 26rem; margin-top: 1rem"></sav-audio>
```

## Overlays

### Dialog — `<sav-dialog>`

A modal window built on the native <dialog>: focus trap, Esc and click outside to close. With sheet-on-mobile it becomes an action sheet on phones (the first demo has it: try it at phone width).

Documentation: https://www.savcomponents.com/#dialog

Attributes:

- `open` (boolean): Shows the dialog.
- `label` (string): Title.
- `sheet-on-mobile` (boolean): On screens up to 640px wide it opens as an action sheet from the bottom, with full-width buttons.
- `persistent` (boolean): Clicking outside does not close it.
- `no-header · no-close` (boolean): 
- `--width` (CSS): Default 32rem.

Slots:

- `(default)`: Body
- `label`: Rich title
- `header-actions`: Buttons next to the close button
- `footer`: Actions

Events:

- `sav-show · sav-after-show`: 
- `sav-request-close`: Cancelable; detail.source = close-button · keyboard · overlay · button
- `sav-hide · sav-after-hide`: 

Methods:

- `show() · hide()`: 
- `[data-sav-close]`: Any element inside with this attribute closes it.

Example — Basic:

```html
<sav-button onclick="document.getElementById('demo-dialog').show()">Open dialog</sav-button>
<sav-dialog id="demo-dialog" label="Delete project?" sheet-on-mobile>
  This removes the project and its 24 files. You can't undo this.
  <sav-button slot="footer" appearance="ghost" variant="neutral" data-sav-close>Cancel</sav-button>
  <sav-button slot="footer" variant="danger" data-sav-close>Delete</sav-button>
</sav-dialog>
<sav-button appearance="outline" onclick="document.getElementById('demo-dialog-2').show()">Persistent</sav-button>
<sav-dialog id="demo-dialog-2" label="Sign in" persistent style="--width: 24rem">
  <div class="stack">
    <sav-input label="Email" type="email" autofocus></sav-input>
    <sav-input label="Password" type="password" password-toggle></sav-input>
  </div>
  <sav-button slot="footer" block data-sav-close>Continue</sav-button>
</sav-dialog>
```

### Drawer — `<sav-drawer>`

A panel that slides in from an edge. Same API as the dialog.

Documentation: https://www.savcomponents.com/#drawer

Attributes:

- `placement` (end · start · top · bottom): Default end.
- `--size` (CSS): Width or height, default 24rem.
- `open · label · persistent`: As in the dialog.

Events:

- `sav-show · sav-hide`: Starts to open or to close.
- `sav-after-show · sav-after-hide`: Finished opening or closing (after the animation).
- `sav-request-close`: Esc, the backdrop or the × asks to close: call event.preventDefault() to keep it open.

Example — Placements:

```html
<sav-button appearance="outline" onclick="document.getElementById('drw-end').show()">End</sav-button>
<sav-button appearance="outline" onclick="document.getElementById('drw-start').show()">Start</sav-button>
<sav-button appearance="outline" onclick="document.getElementById('drw-bottom').show()">Bottom</sav-button>
<sav-drawer id="drw-end" label="Filters">
  <div class="stack">
    <sav-checkbox checked>In stock</sav-checkbox>
    <sav-checkbox>Free shipping</sav-checkbox>
    <sav-range label="Max price" value="60" show-value unit=" €"></sav-range>
  </div>
  <sav-button slot="footer" data-sav-close>Apply</sav-button>
</sav-drawer>
<sav-drawer id="drw-start" label="Menu" placement="start" style="--size: 17rem">Navigation goes here.</sav-drawer>
<sav-drawer id="drw-bottom" label="Share" placement="bottom" style="--size: 14rem">A bottom sheet, handy on phones.</sav-drawer>
```

### Dropdown — `<sav-dropdown · sav-menu-item>`

A menu that opens from a trigger. Arrow keys, type-ahead, Esc; closes when clicking outside.

Documentation: https://www.savcomponents.com/#dropdown

Attributes:

- `placement` (bottom-start · bottom-end · top-start · top-end · right-start …): 
- `multiple` (boolean): Every item is a checkbox and the menu stays open; read the choices from value.
- `sheet-on-mobile` (boolean): On phones the menu rises from the bottom.
- `label` (string): Title of the sheet on phones.
- `stay-open` (boolean): Keeps it open after a choice.
- `disabled` (boolean): 
- `--min-width · --max-height` (CSS): 
- `value · disabled · variant="danger" · type="checkbox" · checked`: On sav-menu-item.

Events:

- `sav-select`: detail.item, detail.value
- `change`: With multiple or checkbox items: detail.value is the list of checked values.
- `sav-show · sav-hide`: 

Methods:

- `show() · hide()`: 
- `value`: The checked values (array).

Example — Basic:

```html
<sav-dropdown id="demo-dd">
  <sav-button slot="trigger" caret appearance="outline" variant="neutral">Actions</sav-button>
  <sav-menu-label>File</sav-menu-label>
  <sav-menu-item value="edit"><sav-icon slot="prefix" name="edit"></sav-icon>Edit<kbd slot="suffix">E</kbd></sav-menu-item>
  <sav-menu-item value="copy"><sav-icon slot="prefix" name="copy"></sav-icon>Duplicate</sav-menu-item>
  <sav-menu-item value="share" disabled><sav-icon slot="prefix" name="link"></sav-icon>Share</sav-menu-item>
  <sav-divider></sav-divider>
  <sav-menu-item type="checkbox" checked value="pin">Pinned</sav-menu-item>
  <sav-menu-item value="delete" variant="danger"><sav-icon slot="prefix" name="trash"></sav-icon>Delete</sav-menu-item>
</sav-dropdown>
<sav-dropdown placement="bottom-end">
  <sav-button slot="trigger" square appearance="ghost" variant="neutral" label="More"><sav-icon name="more-horizontal"></sav-icon></sav-button>
  <sav-menu-item>Profile</sav-menu-item>
  <sav-menu-item>Sign out</sav-menu-item>
</sav-dropdown>
<script>document.getElementById('demo-dd').addEventListener('sav-select', e => Sav.toast('Selected: ' + e.detail.value, {variant: 'neutral', duration: 2000}))</script>
```

Example — Several choices:

```html
<sav-dropdown multiple id="demo-dd-multi" label="Columns">
  <sav-button slot="trigger" caret appearance="outline" variant="neutral" icon="filter">Columns</sav-button>
  <sav-menu-item value="name" checked>Name</sav-menu-item>
  <sav-menu-item value="email" checked>Email</sav-menu-item>
  <sav-menu-item value="phone">Phone</sav-menu-item>
  <sav-menu-item value="city">City</sav-menu-item>
</sav-dropdown>
<script>document.getElementById('demo-dd-multi').addEventListener('change', e => Sav.toast('Shown: ' + e.detail.value.join(', '), {variant: 'neutral', duration: 2000}))</script>
```

### Context menu — `<sav-context-menu · sav-menu-item>`

Your own menu for the right click on an area of the page, instead of the browser’s. It also opens with a long press on phones and tablets, and with the menu key or Shift F10 on the focused area. It opens at the pointer and turns to another corner near the edges of the window; items can hold submenus that fly out to the side. Same items as the dropdown; in text fields the browser’s menu stays, for copy and paste. Opened with the pointer it leaves the focus where it was, so a text field keeps its caret. [object Object]

Documentation: https://www.savcomponents.com/#context-menu

Attributes:

- `for` (id): The element whose right click opens the menu. Without it, the elements inside with slot="target" are the area.
- `label` (string): Name of the menu for screen readers, and title of the sheet on phones.
- `sheet-on-mobile` (boolean): On phones the menu rises from the bottom.
- `stay-open` (boolean): Keeps it open after a choice.
- `disabled` (boolean): The browser’s own menu shows again.
- `--min-width · --max-height` (CSS): 
- `value · disabled · variant="danger" · type="checkbox" · checked`: On sav-menu-item.
- `<sav-menu slot="submenu">`: Inside a sav-menu-item: a submenu that flies out to the side (on the left when there is no room on the right).

Slots:

- `target`: The area that opens the menu, when for is not used.
- `(default)`: sav-menu-item, sav-menu-label and sav-divider.

Events:

- `sav-show`: Before it opens: detail.target is the element right-clicked, detail.x and detail.y the point. Call event.preventDefault() to let the browser’s menu show instead.
- `sav-select`: detail.item, detail.value, detail.checked (checkbox items), detail.target
- `change`: With checkbox items: detail.value is the list of checked values.
- `sav-hide`: 

Methods:

- `show(x, y) · hide()`: show() with a point of the window (clientX, clientY) leaves the focus where it is; without one it opens under the area and the focus moves into the menu, as from the keyboard.
- `target`: The area; set it to an element from script.
- `contextTarget`: The element right-clicked the last time.

Example — Right click on an area:

```html
<sav-context-menu id="demo-ctx" label="Photo">
  <sav-card slot="target" tabindex="0" style="flex: 1 1 100%; text-align: center; cursor: context-menu">
    <sav-icon name="mouse-right" style="font-size: 2rem"></sav-icon>
    <p>Right-click here, long-press on a phone, or focus it and press Shift F10.</p>
  </sav-card>
  <sav-menu-item value="open"><sav-icon slot="prefix" name="external-link"></sav-icon>Open</sav-menu-item>
  <sav-menu-item value="rename"><sav-icon slot="prefix" name="pencil"></sav-icon>Rename<sav-kbd slot="suffix" size="sm">F2</sav-kbd></sav-menu-item>
  <sav-menu-item value="duplicate"><sav-icon slot="prefix" name="copy"></sav-icon>Duplicate<sav-kbd slot="suffix" size="sm">mod+D</sav-kbd></sav-menu-item>
  <sav-menu-item><sav-icon slot="prefix" name="share"></sav-icon>Share
    <sav-menu slot="submenu">
      <sav-menu-item value="link"><sav-icon slot="prefix" name="link"></sav-icon>Copy link</sav-menu-item>
      <sav-menu-item value="email"><sav-icon slot="prefix" name="mail"></sav-icon>Email</sav-menu-item>
      <sav-menu-item value="message"><sav-icon slot="prefix" name="message-circle"></sav-icon>Message</sav-menu-item>
    </sav-menu>
  </sav-menu-item>
  <sav-divider></sav-divider>
  <sav-menu-item type="checkbox" checked value="favourite">Favourite</sav-menu-item>
  <sav-menu-item value="print" disabled><sav-icon slot="prefix" name="printer"></sav-icon>Print</sav-menu-item>
  <sav-divider></sav-divider>
  <sav-menu-item value="delete" variant="danger"><sav-icon slot="prefix" name="trash"></sav-icon>Delete<sav-kbd slot="suffix" size="sm">Del</sav-kbd></sav-menu-item>
</sav-context-menu>
<script>document.getElementById('demo-ctx').addEventListener('sav-select', e => Sav.toast('Chosen: ' + e.detail.value, {variant: 'neutral', duration: 2000}))</script>
```

Example — One menu for many rows:

```html
<sav-list id="demo-files" style="flex: 1 1 100%">
  <sav-list-item button description="48 KB · today"><sav-icon slot="prefix" name="file-text"></sav-icon>Notes.txt</sav-list-item>
  <sav-list-item button description="2.4 MB · yesterday"><sav-icon slot="prefix" name="file-spreadsheet"></sav-icon>Budget 2027.xlsx</sav-list-item>
  <sav-list-item button description="3.1 MB · last week"><sav-icon slot="prefix" name="image"></sav-icon>Holiday.jpg</sav-list-item>
</sav-list>
<sav-context-menu for="demo-files" id="demo-ctx-files" label="File">
  <sav-menu-item value="Open">Open</sav-menu-item>
  <sav-menu-item value="Download"><sav-icon slot="prefix" name="download"></sav-icon>Download</sav-menu-item>
  <sav-menu-item value="Starred"><sav-icon slot="prefix" name="star"></sav-icon>Add to starred</sav-menu-item>
  <sav-divider></sav-divider>
  <sav-menu-item value="Deleted" variant="danger"><sav-icon slot="prefix" name="trash"></sav-icon>Delete</sav-menu-item>
</sav-context-menu>
<script>
// between the rows the browser's own menu stays
document.getElementById('demo-ctx-files').addEventListener('sav-show', e => { if (!e.detail.target?.closest('sav-list-item')) e.preventDefault(); });
document.getElementById('demo-ctx-files').addEventListener('sav-select', e => Sav.toast(e.detail.value + ': ' + e.detail.target.closest('sav-list-item').textContent.trim(), {variant: 'neutral', duration: 2000}));
</script>
```

### Info tip — `<sav-info-tip>`

A small button (an icon, or an icon with text) that opens a box of information when pressed: for help next to a field, a title or a setting. Unlike the tooltip it opens on click, so it works on phones and can hold links.

Documentation: https://www.savcomponents.com/#info-tip

Attributes:

- `content` (string): The text of the box (or put rich content inside).
- `heading` (string): Bold first line of the box.
- `icon` (icon name): Default help-circle.
- `label` (string): Text next to the icon.
- `variant` (neutral · primary): 
- `size` (sm · md): 
- `placement` (top · bottom · left · right): Default top; it flips when there is no room.
- `sheet-on-mobile` (boolean): On phones the box rises from the bottom.

Slots:

- `(default)`: Rich content of the box
- `trigger`: Your own trigger instead of the icon

Events:

- `sav-show · sav-hide`: 

Methods:

- `show() · hide()`: 

Example — Next to a label:

```html
<sav-input placeholder="IT60 X054 2811 1010 0000 0123 456">
  <span slot="label">IBAN <sav-info-tip content="The 27 characters of your bank account, starting with IT. You find it in your bank's app."></sav-info-tip></span>
</sav-input>
```

Example — Icon, text, heading:

```html
<sav-info-tip heading="Why we ask" content="We use your phone only to send the delivery updates."></sav-info-tip>
<sav-info-tip icon="info" label="How it works" variant="primary" heading="Three steps">Choose a plan, add your team and <a href="#start">start</a>. You can change everything later.</sav-info-tip>
<sav-info-tip icon="shield" label="Privacy" placement="bottom" sheet-on-mobile>Nothing leaves your device until you press Save.</sav-info-tip>
```

### Tooltip — `<sav-tooltip>`

A short hint on hover or focus. It flips when there is no room.

Documentation: https://www.savcomponents.com/#tooltip

Attributes:

- `content` (string): Text of the tooltip.
- `placement` (top · bottom · left · right (+ -start / -end)): 
- `trigger` (hover focus · click): Space separated.
- `delay` (ms): Default 150.
- `disabled` (boolean): 
- `--max-width` (CSS): 
- `auto-text` (boolean): Black or white text, whichever is readable on the tooltip colour (--sav-color-tooltip-bg) (WCAG AA, at least 4.5:1), also with your own colours.

Slots:

- `(default)`: The trigger
- `content`: Rich content

Example — Placements:

```html
<sav-tooltip content="On top"><sav-button appearance="outline" variant="neutral">Top</sav-button></sav-tooltip>
<sav-tooltip content="Below" placement="bottom"><sav-button appearance="outline" variant="neutral">Bottom</sav-button></sav-tooltip>
<sav-tooltip content="On the left" placement="left"><sav-button appearance="outline" variant="neutral">Left</sav-button></sav-tooltip>
<sav-tooltip placement="right"><sav-button appearance="outline" variant="neutral">Rich</sav-button><span slot="content"><b>Tip:</b> press <kbd>/</kbd> to search</span></sav-tooltip>
<sav-tooltip content="Opened by click" trigger="click"><sav-button appearance="soft">Click</sav-button></sav-tooltip>
```

### Popover — `<sav-popover>`

A panel next to a button with anything inside — text, a small form, a list. A click on the trigger opens it, Esc or a click outside closes it, and the focus goes into the panel and back. Bigger than a tooltip or an info tip, lighter than a dialog; it leans in Tilt and turns to glass in Glass.

Documentation: https://www.savcomponents.com/#popover

Attributes:

- `heading` (string): A title at the top of the panel (also its name for screen readers).
- `placement` (bottom-start · bottom · bottom-end · top-start · top · top-end · left · right · right-start): Where the panel opens (it flips when there is no room). Default bottom-start.
- `no-close` (boolean): No × button (Esc and a click outside still close it).
- `sheet-on-mobile` (boolean): On phones it slides up from the bottom.
- `label` (string): Name for screen readers when there is no heading.
- `--width` (CSS): Widest the panel gets (default 20rem).

Slots:

- `trigger`: The button (or any focusable element) that opens it.
- `(default)`: The content of the panel.

CSS parts:

- `b`: o
- `h`: e
- `c`: l

Events:

- `sav-show · sav-hide`: The panel opened or closed.

Methods:

- `show() · hide()`: 
- `open`: true while it is open.

Example — A small form:

```html
<sav-popover heading="Share this page">
  <sav-button slot="trigger" appearance="outline" variant="neutral"><sav-icon slot="prefix" name="share"></sav-icon>Share</sav-button>
  <p style="margin: 0 0 .6rem">Anyone with the link can see it.</p>
  <div style="display: flex; gap: .5rem; align-items: center">
    <sav-input size="sm" value="https://example.com/p/42" readonly style="flex: 1"></sav-input>
    <sav-copy-button value="https://example.com/p/42"></sav-copy-button>
  </div>
</sav-popover>
```

Example — Placement, without a close button:

```html
<sav-popover placement="top" no-close label="Profile">
  <sav-avatar slot="trigger" initials="AL" label="Ada Lovelace" button></sav-avatar>
  <b>Ada Lovelace</b><br><span style="color: var(--sav-color-text-muted)">Editor · online</span>
</sav-popover>
<sav-popover placement="right-start" heading="Filters" sheet-on-mobile>
  <sav-button slot="trigger" appearance="soft"><sav-icon slot="prefix" name="sliders-horizontal"></sav-icon>Filters</sav-button>
  <div style="display: grid; gap: .5rem"><sav-checkbox checked>In stock</sav-checkbox><sav-checkbox>On sale</sav-checkbox><sav-checkbox>Free delivery</sav-checkbox></div>
</sav-popover>
```

### Command palette — `<sav-command>`

A search box over the page with everything you can do or open: type a few letters, move with the arrows, Enter. It opens with a shortcut from anywhere (⌘K on a Mac, Ctrl+K elsewhere), groups commands, shows their icons and shortcuts and highlights what matches.

Documentation: https://www.savcomponents.com/#command

Attributes:

- `hotkey` (string): The shortcut that opens and closes it: mod+k (⌘K on a Mac, Ctrl+K elsewhere), ctrl+p, alt+space…
- `placeholder` (string): Text in the empty search box.
- `empty-label` (string): Text when nothing matches (default “Nothing found”).
- `label` (string): Name for screen readers (default “Commands”).

Slots:

- `(default)`: commands, in for groups: value, data-icon, data-description, data-shortcut, data-keywords, data-href.

CSS parts:

- `d`: i
- `b`: a
- `i`: n
- `l`: i
- `c`: l

Events:

- `sav-select`: A command was chosen: detail.value, detail.item (cancel it to keep the palette open).
- `sav-show · sav-hide`: Opened or closed.

Methods:

- `show() · hide()`: 
- `commands`: The commands as a list ({ label, value, icon, description, shortcut, keywords, group, href }); set it to fill the palette from code.

Example — Press the shortcut, or the button:

```html
<sav-button id="cmdOpen" appearance="outline" variant="neutral"><sav-icon slot="prefix" name="search"></sav-icon>Search commands <sav-kbd slot="suffix" size="sm">mod+K</sav-kbd></sav-button>
<sav-command id="cmdDemo" hotkey="mod+k" placeholder="What do you want to do?">
  <optgroup label="Pages">
    <option value="home" data-icon="home" data-description="Start page">Home</option>
    <option value="components" data-icon="blocks" data-description="Every component" data-keywords="list library">Components</option>
    <option value="settings" data-icon="settings" data-shortcut="mod+,">Settings</option>
  </optgroup>
  <optgroup label="Actions">
    <option value="new" data-icon="plus" data-shortcut="mod+n">New project</option>
    <option value="invite" data-icon="user-plus" data-description="Send an invitation by email">Invite people</option>
    <option value="dark" data-icon="moon">Switch to dark mode</option>
  </optgroup>
</sav-command>
<script>
  document.getElementById('cmdOpen').addEventListener('click', () => document.getElementById('cmdDemo').show());
  document.getElementById('cmdDemo').addEventListener('sav-select', (e) => Sav.toast('Chosen: ' + e.detail.value));
</script>
```

## Navigation

### Tabs — `<sav-tabs · sav-tab>`

Switch between panels. Each sav-tab is both the button label and its panel.

Documentation: https://www.savcomponents.com/#tabs

Attributes:

- `appearance` (underline · pills · segmented): Default underline.
- `orientation` (horizontal · vertical): horizontal: a bar above the panels (the default); vertical: a column of tabs beside them.
- `side` (start · end): Vertical tabs: start puts the column on the left (the default), end on the right (the fold handle and the tooltips then sit on its left side).
- `active` (tab name): Tab to open first.
- `label · name · icon · active · disabled`: On sav-tab.
- `collapsible` (boolean): Vertical tabs: a button under the tabs folds them to icons only (collapsed) and opens them again (expanded).
- `collapsed` (boolean): Vertical tabs: only the icons show (or the first letter of a tab without icon); the names become tooltips. Set it to start collapsed; the button changes it.
- `collapse-label · expand-label` (string): Text of the fold button. Default "Collapse" and "Expand".
- `collapse-button` (edge · row): Where the fold button goes: edge (a small handle on the outer border of the rail — right with start, left with end — next to the first tab, the default) or row (a row with text at the bottom of the rail).
- `icon-placement` (start · after · end): Where the icon of a tab goes: start (before the text, the default), after (right after the text) or end (at the far end of the tab, with space in between; clearest in vertical tabs). On sav-tabs it applies to every tab; on one sav-tab it applies to that tab only.
- `level` (normal · sub): On sav-tab: sub sits under the tab before it, smaller and indented (two levels; clearest with vertical tabs).
- `--sav-tab-sub-indent` (CSS): How far sub tabs are indented (default .9rem).
- `--sav-tab-padding` (CSS): Panel padding.
- `auto-text` (boolean): The text of the selected tab is black or white, whichever is readable on its highlight (WCAG AA, at least 4.5:1), also with your own colours.

CSS parts:

- `n`: a
- `t`: a
- `s`: u
- `t`: a
- `t`: a
- `i`: n
- `p`: a
- `r`: a
- `c`: o

Events:

- `sav-tab-show`: detail.name, detail.index
- `sav-collapse`: Vertical tabs folded or opened: detail.collapsed.

Methods:

- `show(nameOrIndex)`: Opens a tab by its name or position.
- `collapse() · expand()`: Vertical tabs: only the icons, or icons and names again.

Example — Appearances:

```html
<sav-tabs>
  <sav-tab label="Overview" icon="home">The overview panel.</sav-tab>
  <sav-tab label="Activity" icon="bell">Recent activity.</sav-tab>
  <sav-tab label="Settings" icon="settings">Settings panel.</sav-tab>
  <sav-tab label="Disabled" disabled></sav-tab>
</sav-tabs>
<sav-tabs appearance="pills">
  <sav-tab label="Monthly">Billed every month.</sav-tab>
  <sav-tab label="Yearly" active>Two months free.</sav-tab>
</sav-tabs>
<sav-tabs appearance="segmented">
  <sav-tab label="List">List view.</sav-tab>
  <sav-tab label="Board">Board view.</sav-tab>
  <sav-tab label="Calendar">Calendar view.</sav-tab>
</sav-tabs>
```

Example — Vertical:

```html
<sav-tabs orientation="vertical">
  <sav-tab label="Account">Account settings.</sav-tab>
  <sav-tab label="Security">Password and two-step login.</sav-tab>
  <sav-tab label="Billing">Invoices and payment methods.</sav-tab>
</sav-tabs>
```

### Accordion — `<sav-accordion · sav-details>`

Expandable sections with a smooth height animation. exclusive keeps only one open.

Documentation: https://www.savcomponents.com/#accordion

Attributes:

- `exclusive` (boolean): On the accordion.
- `appearance` (boxed · plain): 
- `summary · open · disabled`: On sav-details.
- `--gap` (CSS): Space between items.

Slots:

- `summary`: Rich summary
- `prefix`: Icon before the summary

Events:

- `sav-show · sav-hide`: On sav-details.

Example — Exclusive:

```html
<sav-accordion exclusive>
  <sav-details summary="What is SavComponents?" open>A set of web components that work in any page, with or without a framework.</sav-details>
  <sav-details summary="Do I need a build step?">No: add one CSS file and one script.</sav-details>
  <sav-details summary="Can I change the colours?">Yes, every colour, radius and size is a CSS custom property.</sav-details>
</sav-accordion>
```

Example — Plain:

```html
<sav-accordion appearance="plain">
  <sav-details summary="Shipping">Free over 50 €.</sav-details>
  <sav-details summary="Returns">30 days to change your mind.</sav-details>
</sav-accordion>
```

### Menu — `<sav-menu · sav-menu-item>`

A menu that stays on the page, in several kinds: a list (a sidebar, a settings page), a bar across the top whose submenus drop down, and a rail of icons whose labels become tooltips and whose submenus fly out to the side — collapsible folds a list into a rail and back. Any item can hold a submenu; the current item is highlighted the way the style says. Same items as the dropdown, with arrow keys.

Documentation: https://www.savcomponents.com/#menu

Attributes:

- `label` (string): Name for screen readers.
- `appearance` (plain · card): 
- `orientation` (vertical · horizontal): horizontal: a bar; its submenus drop down.
- `collapsed` (boolean): A rail: icons only, the labels become tooltips, submenus fly out to the side.
- `collapsible` (boolean): Adds the button that folds the list into a rail and back.
- `selectable` (boolean): Marks the clicked item as current (also inside submenus).
- `current · open · value · variant · type · disabled`: sav-menu-item; open shows its submenu.
- `<sav-menu slot="submenu">` (child): Inside a sav-menu-item: its submenu (it can hold more).
- `auto-text` (boolean): The current item is black or white, whichever is readable on its highlight (WCAG AA, at least 4.5:1), also with your own colours. Set it on the outer sav-menu: it reaches the submenus too.

Events:

- `sav-select`: detail.value, detail.item
- `sav-toggle`: detail.item, detail.open (a submenu) · detail.collapsed (the rail)

Example — Sidebar list:

```html
<sav-menu label="Account" appearance="card" selectable style="width: 15rem">
  <sav-menu-label>Account</sav-menu-label>
  <sav-menu-item value="profile" current><sav-icon slot="prefix" name="user"></sav-icon>Profile</sav-menu-item>
  <sav-menu-item value="security"><sav-icon slot="prefix" name="lock"></sav-icon>Security</sav-menu-item>
  <sav-menu-item value="billing"><sav-icon slot="prefix" name="credit-card"></sav-icon>Billing</sav-menu-item>
  <sav-divider></sav-divider>
  <sav-menu-item value="logout" variant="danger"><sav-icon slot="prefix" name="log-out"></sav-icon>Sign out</sav-menu-item>
</sav-menu>
```

Example — Submenus that open in place:

```html
<sav-menu label="Documents" appearance="card" selectable style="width: 16rem">
  <sav-menu-item value="home" current><sav-icon slot="prefix" name="home"></sav-icon>Home</sav-menu-item>
  <sav-menu-item open><sav-icon slot="prefix" name="folder"></sav-icon>Projects
    <sav-menu slot="submenu">
      <sav-menu-item value="website">Website</sav-menu-item>
      <sav-menu-item value="app">Phone app</sav-menu-item>
      <sav-menu-item value="brand">Brand book</sav-menu-item>
    </sav-menu>
  </sav-menu-item>
  <sav-menu-item><sav-icon slot="prefix" name="users"></sav-icon>Team
    <sav-menu slot="submenu">
      <sav-menu-item value="people">People</sav-menu-item>
      <sav-menu-item value="roles">Roles</sav-menu-item>
    </sav-menu>
  </sav-menu-item>
  <sav-menu-item value="settings"><sav-icon slot="prefix" name="settings"></sav-icon>Settings</sav-menu-item>
</sav-menu>
```

### Header — `<sav-header>`

The top bar of a site or app: logo, links, search and actions (an avatar, buttons). When the header is too narrow for everything — its own width, so it works in any layout — the links fold behind a menu button and the search folds into a button that opens the field across the whole header, with an X to close it. The current link is highlighted like the breadcrumb: a tint, a leaning tile, an underline, an inked block or glass, by style.

Documentation: https://www.savcomponents.com/#header

Attributes:

- `align` (start · center · end): Where the links sit in the free room between logo and actions.
- `appearance` (bar · transparent · floating · plain): bar: a surface with a line under it (default); transparent: blurred; floating: a panel with a shadow (leans in Tilt); plain: no background.
- `sticky` (boolean): Stays at the top while the page scrolls.
- `breakpoint` (number): Below this width (px, of the header itself) the links fold behind a menu button. Without it they fold when everything no longer fits on one line.
- `search-collapse` (auto · always · never): When the search becomes a button that opens the field across the header: when narrow (default), always, or never.
- `menu-button` (start · end): Side of the menu button when narrow.
- `label` (string): Name of the navigation (default “Main”).
- `slot="logo" · slot="search" · slot="actions"`: The links go in the default slot; mark the current one with aria-current="page".
- `--height · --padding · --search-width · --sav-header-bg` (CSS): Size, side padding, width of the open search, background.
- `toggleMenu() · toggleSearch()` (method): Open or close the folded menu or search (pass true or false).
- `auto-text` (boolean): The link of the current page (aria-current="page") is black or white, whichever is readable on its highlight (WCAG AA, at least 4.5:1), also with your own colours.

Events:

- `sav-toggle`: detail.part (menu · search), detail.open

Example — Logo, links, search and avatar:

```html
<sav-header>
  <a slot="logo" href="#header"><img src="docs/logo.svg" width="28" height="28" alt="">Acme</a>
  <a href="#header" aria-current="page">Home</a>
  <a href="#header">Products</a>
  <a href="#header">Pricing</a>
  <a href="#header">About</a>
  <sav-search slot="search" placeholder="Search" size="sm"></sav-search>
  <sav-avatar slot="actions" initials="AL" label="Ada Lovelace" style="--size: 2rem"></sav-avatar>
</sav-header>
```

Example — Links in the centre, floating, with buttons:

```html
<sav-header align="center" appearance="floating">
  <a slot="logo" href="#header"><img src="docs/logo.svg" width="28" height="28" alt="">Acme</a>
  <a href="#header" aria-current="page">Home</a>
  <a href="#header">Products</a>
  <a href="#header">Pricing</a>
  <a href="#header">About</a>
  <sav-button slot="actions" size="sm" appearance="ghost" variant="neutral">Sign in</sav-button>
  <sav-button slot="actions" size="sm">Get started</sav-button>
</sav-header>
```

### Bottom navigation — `<sav-bottom-nav · sav-bottom-nav-item>`

The bar at the bottom of a phone app: 3–5 destinations with icon and label, a badge, the current one marked. With fixed it sticks to the bottom; with mobile-only it hides on wide screens.

Documentation: https://www.savcomponents.com/#bottom-nav

Attributes:

- `fixed` (boolean): Sticks to the bottom of the window.
- `mobile-only` (boolean): With fixed: hidden above 760px.
- `label` (string): Name of the navigation.
- `icon · label · href · badge · current · value`: sav-bottom-nav-item.

Events:

- `sav-select`: detail.value, detail.item

Example — Four destinations:

```html
<sav-bottom-nav label="Main" style="width: 100%; max-width: 24rem">
  <sav-bottom-nav-item icon="home" label="Home" current></sav-bottom-nav-item>
  <sav-bottom-nav-item icon="search" label="Search"></sav-bottom-nav-item>
  <sav-bottom-nav-item icon="bell" label="Alerts" badge="3"></sav-bottom-nav-item>
  <sav-bottom-nav-item icon="user" label="Profile"></sav-bottom-nav-item>
</sav-bottom-nav>
```

### Breadcrumb — `<sav-breadcrumb>`

Shows where the page sits in the site. The current page (the last item) is highlighted the way the style says: a tint in Soft, a leaning tile in Tilt, an underline in Sharp, an inked block in Brutal, glass in Glass. Long paths can fold the middle behind “…”.

Documentation: https://www.savcomponents.com/#breadcrumb

Attributes:

- `separator` (string): On the breadcrumb; default a chevron.
- `appearance` (plain · contained): contained puts the path in a bar.
- `max-items` (number): Longer paths show the first item, “…” (click to open) and the last ones.
- `label` (string): Accessible name (default “Breadcrumb”).
- `href` (url): On each item.
- `--sav-breadcrumb-current-bg · -fg · -shadow` (CSS): How the current page is highlighted.
- `auto-text` (boolean): The current page is black or white, whichever is readable on its highlight (WCAG AA, at least 4.5:1), also with your own colours.

Example — Basic:

```html
<sav-breadcrumb>
  <sav-breadcrumb-item href="#breadcrumb"><sav-icon slot="prefix" name="home"></sav-icon>Home</sav-breadcrumb-item>
  <sav-breadcrumb-item href="#breadcrumb">Projects</sav-breadcrumb-item>
  <sav-breadcrumb-item>SavComponents</sav-breadcrumb-item>
</sav-breadcrumb>
<sav-breadcrumb separator="/">
  <sav-breadcrumb-item href="#breadcrumb">Docs</sav-breadcrumb-item>
  <sav-breadcrumb-item href="#breadcrumb">Components</sav-breadcrumb-item>
  <sav-breadcrumb-item>Breadcrumb</sav-breadcrumb-item>
</sav-breadcrumb>
```

Example — In a bar, long path folded:

```html
<sav-breadcrumb appearance="contained" max-items="3">
  <sav-breadcrumb-item href="#breadcrumb"><sav-icon slot="prefix" name="home"></sav-icon>Home</sav-breadcrumb-item>
  <sav-breadcrumb-item href="#breadcrumb">Shop</sav-breadcrumb-item>
  <sav-breadcrumb-item href="#breadcrumb">Outdoor</sav-breadcrumb-item>
  <sav-breadcrumb-item href="#breadcrumb">Backpacks</sav-breadcrumb-item>
  <sav-breadcrumb-item>Hiking backpack 30 L</sav-breadcrumb-item>
</sav-breadcrumb>
```

### Pagination — `<sav-pagination>`

Page numbers for long lists and tables: always the first and the last, the pages around the current one and “…” in between, previous and next. The current page is highlighted like the breadcrumb, by style. Links (href="?page={page}") or buttons that fire sav-page.

Documentation: https://www.savcomponents.com/#pagination

Attributes:

- `page` (number): The current page, from 1.
- `pages` (number): How many pages; or give total and page-size.
- `total · page-size` (number): Number of items and items per page (default 10).
- `siblings` (number): Pages shown on each side of the current one (default 1).
- `href` (string): Turns pages into links; {page} is replaced with the number.
- `appearance` (numbers · simple): simple: only ‹ “3 of 12” ›.
- `labels` (boolean): Writes Previous and Next next to the arrows.
- `align` (start · center · end): 
- `size` (sm · md · lg): 
- `label` (string): Name of the navigation (default “Pages”).
- `auto-text` (boolean): The number of the current page is black or white, whichever is readable on its highlight (WCAG AA, at least 4.5:1), also with your own colours.

CSS parts:

- `b`: a
- `p`: a
- `p`: r
- `n`: e
- `s`: u

Events:

- `sav-page`: A page was chosen: detail.page, detail.previous. Cancel it to stay.
- `change`: The page changed (buttons): detail.page.

Example — Numbers, and simple:

```html
<sav-pagination pages="20" page="6"></sav-pagination>
<sav-pagination pages="20" page="6" siblings="2" labels size="sm"></sav-pagination>
<sav-pagination appearance="simple" pages="12" page="3"></sav-pagination>
```

Example — From the number of items, centred:

```html
<sav-pagination total="248" page-size="25" page="1" align="center" style="width: 100%"></sav-pagination>
```

### Steps — `<sav-steps · sav-step>`

The steps of a task — sign-up, checkout, a set-up: the done ones with a tick and a coloured line, the current one marked, the next ones waiting. Across or down; with clickable people go back to a step already done. The markers take the shape and lean of the style.

Documentation: https://www.savcomponents.com/#steps

Attributes:

- `current` (number): The step you are on, from 1 (steps before it are done; one past the last means all done).
- `orientation` (horizontal · vertical): 
- `clickable` (boolean): Steps already done can be clicked to go back.
- `label` (string): Name of the list (default “Steps”).
- `label · description · icon · status`: On sav-step; status="error" marks a step that went wrong.
- `auto-text` (boolean): The number or tick of the done, current and failed steps is black or white, whichever is readable on its marker (WCAG AA, at least 4.5:1), also with your own colours.

CSS parts:

- `b`: a
- `m`: a
- `l`: a
- `d`: e
- `l`: i

Events:

- `sav-step`: A done step was clicked: detail.index (cancel it to stay).
- `change`: The current step changed: detail.current.

Methods:

- `next() · previous()`: One step forward or back.
- `current`: The current step (number).

Example — Across:

```html
<sav-steps current="2" style="width: 100%">
  <sav-step label="Account" description="Email and password"></sav-step>
  <sav-step label="Profile" description="Name and photo"></sav-step>
  <sav-step label="Plan" description="Free or Pro"></sav-step>
  <sav-step label="Done"></sav-step>
</sav-steps>
```

Example — Down, clickable, with icons and an error:

```html
<sav-steps orientation="vertical" current="3" clickable id="stepsDemo">
  <sav-step label="Cart" icon="shopping-cart" description="3 items"></sav-step>
  <sav-step label="Delivery" icon="truck" description="Click to go back here"></sav-step>
  <sav-step label="Payment" icon="credit-card" status="error" description="The card was declined"></sav-step>
  <sav-step label="Confirmation" icon="check"></sav-step>
</sav-steps>
<div class="row"><sav-button size="sm" appearance="outline" variant="neutral" onclick="document.getElementById('stepsDemo').previous()">Back</sav-button><sav-button size="sm" onclick="document.getElementById('stepsDemo').next()">Next</sav-button></div>
```

### Level path — `<sav-level-path · sav-level>`

The map of a course, as in learning apps and games: levels on a winding line. The ones done are coloured, with a tick or their icon and their stars; the current one breathes and says what to do (Start); the next ones are locked. The nodes take the shape of the style: round, square, a leaning tile in Tilt. A heading, a divider or a card inside starts a new stretch, across the whole width.

Documentation: https://www.savcomponents.com/#level-path

Attributes:

- `current` (number): The level the learner is on, from 1: the ones before it are done, the ones after it locked. One past the last: all done.
- `open` (boolean): The levels after the current one are open (outlined) instead of locked.
- `wave` (none · sm · md · lg · px): How far the line winds left and right (default md; it never leaves the width of the path).
- `current-label` (string): The bubble over the current level (default “Start”; empty: no bubble).
- `no-line` (boolean): No line between the levels.
- `label` (string): Name of the path for screen readers (default “Levels”).
- `label · icon · stars · milestone · status · variant · href · target · value`: On sav-level: its name; its icon (otherwise a tick when done, the number when not); stars from 0 to 3 (shown when the attribute is there); milestone makes it bigger; status (done · current · locked · open) overrides what current says; variant its colour; href makes it a link; value goes in the events.
- `--sav-level-gap · --sav-level-label-bg · --size` (CSS): Space between the levels (default 1.7rem); the colour behind the names (default the page, so the line passes behind them); on sav-level, the size of the node.

CSS parts:

- `b`: a
- `l`: i
- `n`: o
- `l`: a
- `s`: t
- `b`: u

Events:

- `sav-select`: A level that is not locked was chosen: detail.index (from 1), detail.value, detail.level.
- `sav-locked`: A locked level was touched, to say why (finish the one before): detail.index, detail.level.

Methods:

- `current`: The current level (number).

Example — A course:

```html
<sav-level-path current="4" label="HTML basics" style="max-width: 26rem; margin: auto">
  <sav-level label="Tags" icon="code" stars="3"></sav-level>
  <sav-level label="Text" icon="type" stars="3"></sav-level>
  <sav-level label="Links" icon="link" stars="2"></sav-level>
  <sav-level label="Images" icon="image"></sav-level>
  <sav-level label="Lists" icon="list"></sav-level>
  <sav-level label="Tables" icon="table"></sav-level>
  <sav-level label="Final test" icon="trophy" milestone variant="warning"></sav-level>
</sav-level-path>
```

Example — Units, and what a click does:

```html
<sav-level-path id="lp-units" current="3" current-label="Continue" label="Spanish for travellers (example)" style="max-width: 26rem; margin: auto">
  <sav-heading level="3" size="5" eyebrow="Unit 1" marker>At the airport</sav-heading>
  <sav-level label="Greetings" icon="hand" stars="3"></sav-level>
  <sav-level label="Check-in" icon="plane" stars="1"></sav-level>
  <sav-level label="Directions" icon="map-pin"></sav-level>
  <sav-divider>Unit 2</sav-divider>
  <sav-level label="At the hotel" icon="hotel"></sav-level>
  <sav-level label="Ordering food" icon="utensils"></sav-level>
  <sav-level label="Review" icon="dumbbell" variant="success" milestone></sav-level>
</sav-level-path>
<script>
  const lp = document.getElementById('lp-units');
  lp.addEventListener('sav-select', (e) => Sav.toast('Open “' + e.detail.level.getAttribute('label') + '” (example)'));
  lp.addEventListener('sav-locked', () => Sav.toast('Finish the level before it first (example)', { variant: 'warning' }));
</script>
```

### Tree — `<sav-tree · sav-tree-item>`

Items inside items that open and close — folders and files, sections and pages. The arrow keys move, → opens or goes in, ← closes or goes to the parent, Enter chooses. The chosen item is highlighted like the current page of the breadcrumb.

Documentation: https://www.savcomponents.com/#tree

Attributes:

- `label` (string): Name of the tree for screen readers.
- `selectable` (boolean): Items with children can be chosen too (otherwise a click opens or closes them).
- `label · value · icon · icon-open · expanded · selected · disabled`: On sav-tree-item; icon-open is the icon while it is open (an open folder).
- `auto-text` (boolean): The selected item is black or white, whichever is readable on its highlight (WCAG AA, at least 4.5:1), also with your own colours.

CSS parts:

- `b`: a
- `i`: t
- `t`: o
- `i`: c
- `l`: a
- `c`: h

Events:

- `sav-select`: An item was chosen: detail.value, detail.item.
- `sav-toggle`: An item opened or closed: detail.item, detail.expanded.

Example — Folders and files:

```html
<sav-tree label="Project files" style="width: 18rem">
  <sav-tree-item label="src" icon="folder" icon-open="folder-open" expanded>
    <sav-tree-item label="components" icon="folder" icon-open="folder-open">
      <sav-tree-item label="button.js" icon="file-code"></sav-tree-item>
      <sav-tree-item label="card.js" icon="file-code"></sav-tree-item>
    </sav-tree-item>
    <sav-tree-item label="index.html" icon="file-code" selected></sav-tree-item>
    <sav-tree-item label="styles.css" icon="file-code"></sav-tree-item>
  </sav-tree-item>
  <sav-tree-item label="images" icon="folder" icon-open="folder-open">
    <sav-tree-item label="logo.svg" icon="image"></sav-tree-item>
  </sav-tree-item>
  <sav-tree-item label="README.md" icon="file-text"></sav-tree-item>
  <sav-tree-item label="secret.env" icon="lock" disabled></sav-tree-item>
</sav-tree>
```

Example — Sections you can choose too (selectable):

```html
<sav-tree selectable label="Settings" style="width: 16rem">
  <sav-tree-item label="Account" expanded><sav-tree-item label="Profile"></sav-tree-item><sav-tree-item label="Security"></sav-tree-item></sav-tree-item>
  <sav-tree-item label="Notifications"><sav-tree-item label="Email"></sav-tree-item><sav-tree-item label="Phone"></sav-tree-item></sav-tree-item>
</sav-tree>
```

### Infinite scroll — `<sav-infinite-scroll>`

Loads more as you reach the end of a list. When the end comes near it fires sav-load; you add the items and call done() — or done(false) when there is nothing more, or fail() on an error. Meanwhile a spinner (the style’s own), at the end a line, on an error “Try again”. It watches the page, or itself when it scrolls; mode="button" waits for a “Load more” button instead.

Documentation: https://www.savcomponents.com/#infinite-scroll

Attributes:

- `mode` (auto · button): auto loads by itself near the end (default); button waits for “Load more”.
- `threshold` (number): How many pixels before the end it starts loading (default 300).
- `loading-label · more-label · end-label · error-label` (string): The texts: “Loading…”, “Load more”, “That’s all”, “It did not load.”
- `retry-label` (string): The text of the Try again button (default "Try again").

CSS parts:

- `b`: a
- `f`: o
- `l`: o
- `m`: o
- `e`: r
- `e`: n

Events:

- `sav-load`: Time to load more: detail.page (1, 2, 3…). Add the items, then call done() or fail().

Methods:

- `done(more = true)`: The items are in; false when there is nothing more.
- `fail()`: Loading failed: shows “Try again”.
- `reset()`: Starts again from page 0 (a new search).
- `load()`: Loads the next page now.
- `page · loading`: Pages loaded so far; true while loading.

Example — In a box that scrolls:

```html
<sav-infinite-scroll id="feedDemo" end-label="You have seen every post" style="display: block; width: 100%; max-height: 18rem; overflow: auto; padding: .25rem">
  <sav-card>Post 1</sav-card><sav-card>Post 2</sav-card><sav-card>Post 3</sav-card>
</sav-infinite-scroll>
<script>
  {
    const feed = document.getElementById('feedDemo');
    // a pretend server: 3 more posts each time, 4 pages in all
    feed.addEventListener('sav-load', (e) => {
      setTimeout(() => {
        const start = feed.children.length;
        for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) feed.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', '<sav-card>Post ' + (start + i) + '</sav-card>');
        feed.done(e.detail.page < 4);
      }, 700);
    });
  }
</script>
```

Example — With a button, and an error:

```html
<sav-infinite-scroll id="moreDemo" mode="button" more-label="Show more products" style="width: 100%">
  <sav-list><sav-list-item>Backpack</sav-list-item><sav-list-item>Tent</sav-list-item></sav-list>
</sav-infinite-scroll>
<script>
  {
    const more = document.getElementById('moreDemo');
    let tries = 0;
    more.addEventListener('sav-load', () => {
      setTimeout(() => {
        // the second time it fails, to show "Try again"
        if (++tries === 2) { more.fail(); return; }
        more.querySelector('sav-list').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', '<sav-list-item>Sleeping bag</sav-list-item><sav-list-item>Stove</sav-list-item>');
        more.done(tries < 4);
      }, 600);
    });
  }
</script>
```

## Charts

### Bar chart — `<sav-chart-bar>`

Bars, vertical or horizontal, one series or several side by side, or stacked; spacing, values on the bars, a hover tooltip and a hidden table for screen readers. Colours come from --sav-chart-1…8.

Documentation: https://www.savcomponents.com/#chart-bar

Attributes:

- `data` (JSON): { labels: [...], series: [{ name, values: [...], color? }] } — or set the .data property.
- `orientation` (vertical · horizontal): 
- `stacked` (boolean): Series on top of each other.
- `gap` (0 – 0.9): Space between groups (default 0.3).
- `show-values` (boolean): Numbers on the bars.
- `max` (number): Top of the scale (default: rounded up from the data).
- `label` (string): What the chart shows (screen readers).
- `height` (px): 
- `no-legend` (boolean): 

Example — Grouped, vertical:

```html
<sav-chart-bar label="Sales per quarter" show-values style="width: 100%" data='{"labels":["Q1","Q2","Q3","Q4"],"series":[{"name":"2025","values":[12,19,15,24]},{"name":"2026","values":[16,22,21,30]}]}'></sav-chart-bar>
```

Example — Stacked, horizontal:

```html
<sav-chart-bar label="Time per task" orientation="horizontal" stacked gap="0.45" show-values style="width: 100%" data='{"labels":["Design","Build","Test"],"series":[{"name":"Ada","values":[6,10,3]},{"name":"Alan","values":[2,12,5]},{"name":"Grace","values":[4,6,8]}]}'></sav-chart-bar>
```

### Pie chart — `<sav-chart-pie>`

A pie or a donut: gaps between slices, percentages, a text in the centre of the donut.

Documentation: https://www.savcomponents.com/#chart-pie

Attributes:

- `data` (JSON): { labels: [...], values: [...] }
- `type` (pie · donut): 
- `thickness` (px): Width of the donut ring.
- `gap` (degrees): Space between slices, as the angle it takes at the edge (default 1.2; 0 for none). The space is equally wide all the way to the centre.
- `show-values` (boolean): Percentages on the slices.
- `center` (string): Text in the middle of the donut.
- `height` (px): Size (default 260).
- `label` (string): The name of the chart (screen readers, and the table under it).

Example — Pie and donut:

```html
<sav-chart-pie label="Traffic sources" show-values style="width: 16rem" data='{"labels":["Search","Social","Direct","Email"],"values":[48,22,18,12]}'></sav-chart-pie>
<sav-chart-pie label="Storage" type="donut" center="72%" gap="2" style="width: 16rem" data='{"labels":["Photos","Videos","Free"],"values":[40,32,28]}'></sav-chart-pie>
```

### Radar chart — `<sav-chart-radar>`

A spider web: one axis per label, one shape per series — to compare profiles on several qualities at once.

Documentation: https://www.savcomponents.com/#chart-radar

Attributes:

- `data` (JSON): { labels: [axes], series: [{ name, values }] }
- `max` (number): 
- `levels` (number): Rings of the web (default 4).
- `no-fill` (boolean): Lines only.
- `height` (px): Size (default 320).
- `label` (string): The name of the chart (screen readers, and the table under it).

Example — Two profiles:

```html
<sav-chart-radar label="Skills" max="10" style="width: 22rem" data='{"labels":["Speed","Design","Code","Tests","Docs","Support"],"series":[{"name":"Team A","values":[8,6,9,5,7,6]},{"name":"Team B","values":[5,9,6,8,6,9]}]}'></sav-chart-radar>
```

### Area and line chart — `<sav-chart-line>`

Values over time as a filled area or a line only: smooth curves, points, stacked areas.

Documentation: https://www.savcomponents.com/#chart-line

Attributes:

- `data` (JSON): { labels: [...], series: [{ name, values }] }
- `type` (area · line): Default area.
- `smooth` (boolean): Curves instead of straight segments.
- `points` (boolean): A dot on every value.
- `stacked` (boolean): Areas on top of each other.
- `max · height`: 
- `label` (string): The name of the chart (screen readers, and the table under it).
- `min` (number): The lowest value of the axis (default 0).

Example — Area, smooth:

```html
<sav-chart-line label="Visitors" smooth style="width: 100%" data='{"labels":["Mon","Tue","Wed","Thu","Fri","Sat","Sun"],"series":[{"name":"This week","values":[120,180,150,210,260,190,240]},{"name":"Last week","values":[100,140,160,150,200,170,180]}]}'></sav-chart-line>
```

Example — Lines with points:

```html
<sav-chart-line label="Temperature" type="line" points style="width: 100%" data='{"labels":["Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun"],"series":[{"name":"Rome","values":[8,9,12,15,19,24]},{"name":"Oslo","values":[-4,-3,1,5,11,15]}]}'></sav-chart-line>
```

### Activity chart — `<sav-chart-activity>`

A calendar heatmap: one column per week, a square per day, darker when the value (1–100) is higher. Good for streaks, contributions, workouts.

Documentation: https://www.savcomponents.com/#chart-activity

Attributes:

- `data` (JSON): { '2026-11-16': 40, … } or [{ date, value }] — values 0–100.
- `start · end` (YYYY-MM-DD): Period (default: the last 12 months).
- `levels` (number): Colour steps (default 5).
- `week-start` (0 · 1): Sunday or Monday (default 1).
- `locale` (string): Month and day names.
- `label` (string): The name of the chart (screen readers, and the table under it).

Example — The last twelve months:

```html
<sav-chart-activity id="act-demo" label="Workouts" style="width: 100%"></sav-chart-activity>
<script>
  // data: { 'YYYY-MM-DD': value 0–100 } (or [{ date, value }]); here random values for the example
  const days = {};
  for (let i = 0; i < 365; i++) { const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() - i); if (Math.random() > 0.45) days[d.toISOString().slice(0, 10)] = Math.round(Math.random() * 100); }
  document.getElementById('act-demo').data = days;
</script>
```

### Map chart — `<sav-chart-map>`

The world coloured by value (a choropleth), or with some countries highlighted; it can zoom on one or more countries. Countries are named in the page language; a click tells which one.

Documentation: https://www.savcomponents.com/#chart-map

Attributes:

- `by` (country · continent): continent: data and highlight name continents ({"europe": 40, "north-america": 25}) and each continent is one area, with one colour, one name and one value (default country).
- `region` (world · europe · africa · asia · north-america · south-america · oceania · antarctica): The continent to show: the map frames it and dims the rest of the world (default world).
- `data` (JSON): { "IT": 40, "FRA": 12 } — alpha-2 or alpha-3 keys.
- `highlight` (list): Countries filled with the main colour (without values).
- `focus` (list): Zoom on these countries.
- `levels` (number): Colour steps (default 5).
- `antarctica` (boolean): Show Antarctica (hidden by default).
- `locale` (string): Language of the country names.
- `max · height · label`: 

Events:

- `sav-country`: A country was clicked. detail.code, detail.value

Example — By continent:

```html
<sav-chart-map region="europe" label="Visitors in Europe" data='{"IT":420,"FR":310,"DE":280,"ES":190,"GB":240,"PL":90,"SE":60,"PT":75}' style="width: 100%"></sav-chart-map>
<sav-chart-map by="continent" label="Sales by continent" data='{"europe":320,"north-america":280,"asia":210,"south-america":90,"africa":40,"oceania":60}' style="width: 100%; margin-top: 1rem"></sav-chart-map>
<sav-chart-map by="continent" highlight="europe" label="Where we ship" style="width: 100%; margin-top: 1rem"></sav-chart-map>
<sav-chart-map region="south-america" highlight="BR AR CL" label="Offices" style="width: 100%; margin-top: 1rem"></sav-chart-map>
```

Example — Values by country:

```html
<sav-chart-map label="Visitors by country" style="width: 100%" data='{"US":420,"BR":180,"IT":160,"DE":150,"FR":120,"GB":110,"IN":240,"JP":90,"AU":60,"CA":80,"ZA":30,"MX":70,"ES":65}'></sav-chart-map>
```

## Sections

### Showcase — `<sav-showcase>`

A section for a product page: screenshots on one side — one or two desktops, one to three phones, or a desktop with phones — and label, title, text and buttons on the other. The buttons here are only examples: on your page they link where you want.

Documentation: https://www.savcomponents.com/#showcase

Attributes:

- `desktop` (url(s)): One or two desktop screenshots, separated by spaces.
- `mobile` (url(s)): One to three phone screenshots, separated by spaces.
- `desktop-alt · mobile-alt` (string): What each screenshot shows, separated by |.
- `eyebrow · heading · text` (string): Label, title, paragraph.
- `reverse` (boolean): Screenshots on the right.

Slots:

- `(default)`: More content under the text.
- `actions`: Buttons (give them an href to link somewhere).

Example — Desktop and phone:

```html
<sav-showcase desktop="docs/media/poster.jpg" mobile="docs/sample.svg" desktop-alt="The app on a computer" mobile-alt="The app on a phone"
  eyebrow="New" heading="Your documents, everywhere" text="Open, sign and share PDFs from the browser or your phone. Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit.">
  <sav-button slot="actions">Try it free</sav-button>
  <sav-button slot="actions" appearance="outline" variant="neutral">Learn more</sav-button>
</sav-showcase>
```

Example — One phone, two phones, three phones:

```html
<sav-showcase mobile="docs/sample.svg" heading="One phone" text="Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet."><sav-button slot="actions">Get the app</sav-button></sav-showcase>
<sav-showcase reverse mobile="docs/sample.svg docs/media/poster.jpg" heading="Two phones" text="Consectetur adipiscing elit, sed do eiusmod."><sav-button slot="actions">Get the app</sav-button></sav-showcase>
<sav-showcase mobile="docs/media/poster.jpg docs/sample.svg docs/media/poster.jpg" heading="Three phones" text="Ut enim ad minim veniam, quis nostrud."><sav-button slot="actions">Get the app</sav-button></sav-showcase>
```
